resources.string: Send or receive one selected file over the trusted connection.
Files are limited to 100 MiB. Each chunk is acknowledged; SHA-256 is checked before the destination is written. Temporary staging is removed after completion or cancellation.
Computer wants to send a file
Accept by choosing a new document in Android. No file is received without your choice. The offer expires after 30 seconds.
Auto can reduce stream quality using measured network conditions. Host limits always apply. Changes apply to the next connection.
Control mode keeps the connection without capturing the desktop.
Connect to a trusted computer first.
First connection: scan the PC QR code and approve this phone on Windows. PIN is available after the PC is trusted.
Lock this computer now? Unlock it locally with your Windows credentials.
Text moves only when you tap a button. No automatic clipboard sync.
Choose what your trusted computer can see. Sharing is off until you enable it.
Tap Allow notification access to open Android settings for ReyDesk, then enable Allow notification access. If Android shows a list, select ReyDesk. Return here to enable sharing and choose your apps.
Open Android Settings and search for Notification access, then select ReyDesk.
Also show codes and bank messages
Verification codes, one-time passwords and bank or payment messages will appear in clear text on your PC. Off by default.

Only selected apps are shared during an authenticated connection. Previews start off. When enabled, ordinary content can be read on the trusted PC even while the phone is locked. Security, bank and verification content stays hidden; locked-phone actions are blocked. Android or work-profile policies may withhold content. No notification history is saved. Android may restrict opening apps or delivering replies.
No app is allowed by default. This list contains launchable apps Android makes visible to ReyDesk.
Loaded from this computer’s local configuration. Each run needs confirmation on the computer.
This computer has no approved apps yet.
No valid app list received. Try refreshing.
Waiting for computer approval and acknowledgement…
Connect to %1$s without a PIN? The saved identity will be verified. This phone must be allowed to reconnect in the computer’s settings; otherwise use QR or PIN.
Only tasks registered on the computer. Each start or stop needs computer approval. Output is shared only with local computer opt-in. Refresh to get current status.
Developer Mode is disabled on this computer.
